newsitem.title: THAILAND: Amnuay says Thai 1996 C/A deficit 8.0 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Amnuay says Thai 1996 C/A deficit 8.0 pct of GDP.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan on Wednesday revised Thailand's 1996 current account deficit to 8.0 percent of gross domestic product against 8.2 percent estimated earlier by the central bank and an actual 8.1 percent in 1995.
The minister announced the lower deficit for last year after reviewing 1996 economic figures with central bank officials.
Market analysts have adopted a negative view of the current account deficit, seeing it as a factor that could destabilise the country's short-term economic outlook.
